label: Shielded — holding the saddle of the pass
injuries: Wing feathers torn from landing in his path once too often

recentEvents.value: The roosts are emptying deeper along the cliffs; it slams into his path the way it turns hikers from cliff edges, and he calls the rescue an ambush.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Its fiercest maneuver is a rescue move; he experiences rescue as attack, every time.

temporaryObjective.value: Hold the saddle until the last roost is evacuated.
